name: Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma (United States)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Great Seal of the Choctaw Nation: a yellow disc bearing a bow, three arrows and a pipe-hatchet within a ring inscribed 'The Great Seal of the Choctaw Nation'.
history: The Choctaw flag, first flown in 1860 during the Civil War, is considered the first flag of a Native American nation. The bow, arrows and pipe-hatchet of the seal stand for defence and peace.

features.role: Great Seal of the Choctaw Nation
